proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B D p h1 h2
  rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right B D p, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev A p] at h1
  rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right D A p, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev B p] at h2
  rw [← vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_right A B p, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev D p]
  simp only [inner_neg_left, inner_sub_right] at h1 h2 ⊢
  have e1 := real_inner_comm (A -ᵥ p) (B -ᵥ p)
  have e2 := real_inner_comm (B -ᵥ p) (D -ᵥ p)
  have e3 := real_inner_comm (D -ᵥ p) (A -ᵥ p)
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B D p : P), inner ℝ (p -ᵥ A) (B -ᵥ D) = 0 → inner ℝ (p -ᵥ B) (D -ᵥ A) = 0 → inner ℝ (p -ᵥ D) (A -ᵥ B) = 0
